in_marathi.name: Sureshwar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sureshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shrī’ which means wealth, prosperity, and Goddess Lakshmi. The suffix ‘shwar’ means ‘lord’ or ‘God’. Thus, Sureshwar can be interpreted as 'God's guarantee' or 'God's lord'.
